headline: Lead Azure DevOps Engineer
page_title: Rajendra P N - Azure GitOps DevOps Engineer
summary_html: Lead Azure DevOps Engineer with 10+ years of enterprise infrastructure, CI/CD automation, Kubernetes engineering, and production operations experience. Builds Azure GitOps delivery with Argo CD, GitHub Actions, Helm, AKS, and Terraform. Standardizes reusable workflows, version-controlled environment configuration, container builds, release promotion, and deployment validation. Administers build runners and Kubernetes services, embeds security and artifact-quality controls, and troubleshoots pipeline, infrastructure, and application failures. Partners with engineering teams on Git-based change governance, observability, operational readiness, and developer self-service using Python, PowerShell, and Bash.
